items.title: A Trip to Guangming Town
items.content_html:
Time: morning of 2019-10-03

I got up early. Guangming Town is still fairly remote, and the subway doesn’t go there. So I got up early and spent over an hour on the subway. At first I set my destination to Guangming Town OTC Happy Farmland, and the bus stop was Second Vocational Technical School. Later, as we were nearly at the stop, I heard someone on the bus saying they were going there, and only then did I learn that the bus stop is the Seventh Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University (or Zhongda Affiliated No. 7).
There’s a parking lot near Zhongda Affiliated No. 7, so coming by car is more convenient.
Get off the bus and walk straight in the direction of traffic.
There were still just as many people in the morning

The viewing platform is the thing in the distance

I walked a long way — personally, I didn’t feel it was close at all.

After going in, follow the road further inside. If you want to go up to the viewing platform (the flower fields near the platform are free of charge), you can buy a ticket at the ticket office; it’s 20 yuan for adults and 10 yuan for children. As for the sightseeing shuttle, it’s 30 yuan for adults (limited to four rides), and I think 10 yuan for children. Actually, I wouldn’t recommend taking it — walking and enjoying the view is better, though it is a bit tiring if you’re not in good shape.

As for the viewing platform, I personally feel it’s better to climb up in the morning or towards evening for the sunrise or sunset; at other times the light is too bright…

From September onwards it’s sunflowers, a very large area of them — I just couldn’t find a good shooting angle

The path below the viewing platform.

A side angle

Pink muhly grass below the viewing platform

Later I added some effects to the pink muhly grass photos at home

Overall it feels like a place suited to bringing small children for some leisure time; it’s a fairly relaxed outing. It’s just that the entrances and exits aren’t arranged very well, the place is remote, the bus information is inaccurate, and it’s best to go straight to the subway station. There are no taxis nearby either…

A guide I’m sharing from my own experience:
Attraction: Guangming Town OTC Happy Farmland — not Guangming Town Happy Farmland; the two are quite different, and they’re also a fair distance apart.
Visitors without a car: get off at Guangsheng (sheng) Factory and walk in via Loucun No. 1 Road (called Shanshui Road on Amap) (a walk of about ten minutes). If you do one loop you’ll come out right at Gate 2, and you can take the bus back from the Seventh Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University (or Zhongda Affiliated No. 7).

Visitors driving: on holidays all vehicles are diverted to Gate 2, and Loucun No. 1 Road (called Shanshui Road on Amap) is not open to them, so for sightseeing there’s just the one road in and out.

items.title: 光明小镇游记
items.content_html:
时间：2019-10-03 上午

早早的起床，光明小镇还是比较偏远的，地铁不通。早早起床赶了一个多小时地铁。刚开始定位的是光明小镇OTC欢乐田园，公交站台是 第二职业技术学校。后来快到站的时候，听到车上有人过去，才知道是中山七院（或中大附七公交站。
中大附七附近有停车场，驾车来比较合适。
下车，直走车流方向。
早上人还是那么多

远处的就是观景台

我走了好远的路，反正个人感觉不近。

进去后，沿着路往里面走。如果想要上观景台（观景台附近的花海不收费）的，可以在售票处买票，大人是20元，小孩是10元。观光小巴的话，大人30元（限乘四次），小孩好像是10元。其实，不建议坐，不如走路观景，就是对于体力不好的有点累。

观景台吧，个人感觉早上或者傍晚登上看日出或者日落景色比较好，其他时段光线太亮了……

九月份往后就是向日葵，面积很大，就是没找到太好的拍摄角度

观景台下面的小道。

侧面角度

观景台下的粉黛乱子草

后来我回家特效了一下粉黛乱子草

整体感觉适合带小孩子来休闲，游玩比较放松。就是出入口安排的有点不太好，还有这个地方偏僻，公交车查的不准，最好直接到地铁站。附近也没有的士……

个人分享攻略：
景点：光明小镇OTC欢乐田园，不是光明小镇欢乐田园，两者差距还是很远的，距离也有点远。
非驾车的游客到光晟（sheng）厂下车，走楼村一号路(高德地图是善水路) 进去（预计走路十分钟）。逛一圈刚好从2号门出来，从中山七院（或中大附七）坐公交回。

驾车游客：节假日所有车辆都分流到二号门，楼村一号路(高德地图是善水路) 是不给进的，游玩的话来回就一条路。
